hollowOrdinalSubstitutions.normalizedSignature: The retained <lane> cases span distinct work identifiers and preserve the same lexical object across their recorded deployments.
hollowOrdinalSubstitutions.ruling: hollow: source plurality and lexical sameness do not report the headword's observed Chan deployment or adjudicate what different thing was tested

hollowOrdinalSubstitutions.normalizedSignature: The <lane> alias preserves the expression's governing image and grammatical direction.
hollowOrdinalSubstitutions.ruling: hollow: no image, direction, alternate query, or rejected alias is named

hollowOrdinalSubstitutions.normalizedSignature: Term=the complete governed expression; Finding=<lane> excludes shortened matches that lose its decisive relation.
hollowOrdinalSubstitutions.ruling: hollow: neither the shortened match nor the lost relation is identified

hollowOrdinalSubstitutions.normalizedSignature: Term=nearby lexical family; Finding=<lane> keeps only exact witnesses of this headword, not merely related imagery.

legitimateRepeatedSchemaLanguage.ruling: legitimate field label: each paired Finding is headword-specific and identifies the actual excluded class (single ink marks, unwitting mistakes, literal kinship, generic fear, gradual entry, isolated weapons, monetary loss, ordinary similes, commodity exchange, or sea imagery)
legitimate: controls name the concrete route/gate mismatch or 正令/祖令 neighboring family and state the distinct semantic boundary

normalization: Before generic digit normalization, replace /\b[ABC]\d{2,4}\b/i with <lane>; otherwise C131 becomes c<n> and word-boundary ordinal rules are fragile.

recommendedDetectorChanges.normalizedRepeatRule: At repeat-floor >=5, fail identical normalized values independently by semantic coordinate. Include EvidenceBody, DifferentThingTest.Reason, AliasRationale, ModifierControls Finding, and FamilyControls Finding.
recommendedDetectorChanges.doNotFlag: Do not fail a repeated generic control Term such as 'nearby formulas' by itself when its paired Finding is independently headword-specific. Flag the row only when both Term is generic and Finding is hollow or repeated.
